import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static Map<BitSet, Integer> nodeMap = new HashMap<>();
    static int N, total;
    static int[][] P = new int[7][7];
    static long[][] dp = new long[2][70003];
    static int[][] trans = new int[70003][128];
    static int[] prob = new int[128];
    static long inv100;

    static int modPow(long base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static int dfs(BitSet x) {
        if (nodeMap.containsKey(x)) {
            return nodeMap.get(x);
        }
        int id = ++total;
        nodeMap.put(x, id);
        BitSet[] tmp = new BitSet[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            tmp[i] = new BitSet(1 << N);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                if (x.get(j)) {
                    tmp[i].set(j | (1 << i));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            BitSet temp = (BitSet) x.clone();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (((mask & (1 << j)) != 0)) {
                    temp.or(tmp[j]);
                }
            }
            trans[id][mask] = dfs(temp);
        }
        return id;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        BitSet startMask = new BitSet(128);
        startMask.set(0);
        total = 0;
        nodeMap.clear();
        dfs(startMask);
        inv100 = modPow(100, MOD - 2);
        System.err.println(nodeMap.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(line[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], 0);
        }
        dp[0][1] = 1;
        int layerIdx = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                prob[j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                    int p_value = ((j & (1 << k)) != 0) ? P[i][k] : 100 - P[i][k];
                    prob[j] = (int)((long)prob[j] * inv100 % MOD * p_value % MOD);
                }
            }
            Arrays.fill(dp[layerIdx ^ 1], 0);
            for (int j = 1; j <= total; j++) {
                if (dp[layerIdx][j] != 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << N); k++) {
                        int t = trans[j][k];
                        dp[layerIdx ^ 1][t] = (dp[layerIdx ^ 1][t] + (long)dp[layerIdx][j] * prob[k]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            layerIdx ^= 1;
        }
        BitSet finalMask = new BitSet(128);
        finalMask.set(0, 128);
        System.out.println(dp[layerIdx][nodeMap.get(finalMask)]);
    }
}
